questions.q: Rewrite $\log_3 81=4$ in exponential form, and verify.
Write $3\log_2 x+\log_2 y$ as a single logarithm.

questions.answer: $\log_2[x(x-2)]=3$, so $x(x-2)=8$, giving $x^2-2x-8=0$, i.e. $(x-4)(x+2)=0$. So $x=4$ or $x=-2$; but $x=-2$ makes the original logarithms undefined, so the only valid solution is $x=4$.

sections.heading: A well-designed word problem: comparing two investment accounts

questions.q: This question has three parts. An investment of 5000 dollars is placed in an account that grows according to $A(t)=5000e^{0.04t}$, where $t$ is measured in years. (a) Find the value of the investment after 10 years, to the nearest dollar. (b) Find how many years it takes for the investment to double, to the nearest tenth of a year, using natural logarithms. (c) A second account offers simple (non-compounded) growth of 5 percent per year on the same initial 5000 dollars. Determine which account has the greater value after 10 years, and by how much, to the nearest dollar.
questions.answer: (a) $A(10)=5000e^{0.4}\approx5000(1.4918)\approx7459$ dollars. (b) Set $10000=5000e^{0.04t}$, so $2=e^{0.04t}$, giving $\ln2=0.04t$, so $t=\dfrac{\ln2}{0.04}\approx\dfrac{0.6931}{0.04}\approx17.3$ years. (c) Simple growth value: $5000+5000(0.05)(10)=5000+2500=7500$ dollars. Since $7500>7459$, the simple-growth account is greater after 10 years, by about $7500-7459=41$ dollars.
